entry.title: One Canada Square
entry.note: The fresh raw OSM way 5986754, tagged Q503477, matches the independently preserved ground outline within 0.002 m rounding. Anchor [-0.019514156, 51.50493389] and heading -0.172600059102 remain fixed. Native +X points ESE at bearing 99.889 degrees toward the asymmetric east entrance projection; +Z points SSW at 189.889 degrees. The shaft centre X=-2.65 m aligns its 57.912 m width with the mapped west and east wall lines, distinct from the 63.145 by 59.259 m base. Owner north-annotated level 35 and 47 plans were actually inspected: two equal inward corner steps, a 154 square metre west terrace and square upper plate independently establish the signed direction. Model Y0 approximates the local apron. Architect 235 m versus registry 236 m is explicitly unresolved, not a surveyed adjustment. The primary supplier confirms nine drums and seven bullnose panels; exact N2/E3/S2/W2 distribution is reconstructed. No footprint replacement. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.
